title: Holding on to nitrogen
desc: Less than half of the fertiliser a farmer spreads ends up in the crop. In a field trial in Japan, a wheat with a trait from a wild grass stays greener and leaks less nitrate, while the soil's microbes follow the fertiliser far more than the wheat.
page: Holding on to nitrogen: a wheat, its soil and the microbes in between
sub: a wheat, its soil and its microbes
aria: Interactive 3D story of how soil microbes turn fertiliser into nitrate and nitrous oxide, a wheat bred to slow them down, and the network of microbes in a field trial
